decisions.reason: The reference electrometer is core to the firm's dosimetry business and is featured on the home page, so dropping it within a year is very unlikely.
The oncology risk management software supports the firm's convergence and automation strategy and still has its own page, though software outside core QA carries some risk of being repositioned.
The CT image quality phantom extends the firm's established imaging QA line and was launched recently, so the firm will keep it.
Mammography phantoms are distant from the core offer and somewhat overlap with Product E, but the firm is expanding in imaging QA and would give a 2024 launch more time.
The full field mammography phantom complements the imaging portfolio despite being outside core competence, and it is too new to drop.
The imaging QA instruments build on the established offer and fit the firm's broad-portfolio expansion strategy.
